claims.text: ApexBrasil announced on 4 November that about 200 Brazilian companies take part in Web Summit Lisboa to seek investment and business in Europe.
claims.quote: Cerca de 200 empresas brasileiras vão participar na Web Summit Lisboa para tentar captar investimento e procurar oportunidades de negócio no mercado europeu, anunciou hoje a Agência Brasileira de Promoção de Exportações e Investimentos (ApexBrasil).

claims.text: From 8 to 13 November the mission led by ApexBrasil with Sebrae Startups brings companies from every region and representatives of ten Brazilian technology parks.
claims.quote: Entre 08 e 13 de novembro, a missão liderada pela ApexBrasil, em parceria com o Sebrae Startups, reúne empresas de todas as regiões do país e representantes de dez parques tecnológicos brasileiros

claims.text: The Brazilian presence centres on a 324 square metre pavilion in the MEO Arena, with a programme from 10 to 12 November.
claims.quote: A presença brasileira terá como centro um pavilhão de 324 metros quadrados na MEO Arena, com programação entre 10 e 12 de novembro.

claims.text: According to the organisers, Brazilian companies raised about 700 million dollars at earlier editions through contacts begun at the event (a figure reported, not checked at its source).
claims.quote: empresas brasileiras captaram cerca de 700 milhões de dólares (623 milhões de euros) nas edições anteriores

claims.text: The Porto edtech startup Intuitivo raised 1.35 million euro in seed funding to expand into Brazil.
claims.quote: Portuguese edtech startup Intuitivo has raised €1.35 million in seed funding to expand into Brazil

claims.text: The round was led by Caixa Capital and the Impact Innovation Fund, managed by 3xP Global.
claims.quote: the funding round was led by Caixa Capital and the Impact Innovation Fund, managed by 3xP Global

claims.text: Intuitivo's platform counts 75,000 registered teachers, in more than 500 schools in Portugal.
claims.quote: The platform now counts 75,000 registered teachers.

claims.text: Intuitivo estimates a potential market in Brazil of 2.2 million teachers, around 12 times the Portuguese market.
claims.quote: a potential market of 2.2 million teachers, around 12 times the Portuguese market

claims.text: Intuitivo already has a team in Brazil and some teachers there using its platform.
claims.quote: The company already has a team on the ground and some teachers in Brazil using its platform.

claims.text: Intuitivo won the PITCH competition at Web Summit in 2024.
claims.quote: won the PITCH competition at Web Summit in 2024
